*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: $REPO_JOB_HUNTER/docker-compose.yml
@@
-# Hot-reload (hybrid: bind mounts + uvicorn --reload):
-#   Code changes in cloud/ and src/ are visible instantly via bind mounts.
-#   Uvicorn's watchfiles-based reloader picks them up in ~0.5s — no container
-#   restart, no log interruption.
+# Development hot-reload is opt-in with UVICORN_RELOAD=1. Retained browser
+# sessions are process-local, so the default must keep the service process alive
+# while an operator pauses and resumes a run.
@@
-#   For dependency changes (pyproject.toml / uv.lock), run:
+#   For dependency changes (pyproject.toml / uv.lock), run:
@@
-    command:
-      - uvicorn
-      - cloud.services.browser_provider.server:app
+    command:
+      - uvicorn
+      - cloud.services.browser_provider.server:app
       - --host=0.0.0.0
       - --port=8787
       - --log-config=cloud/uvicorn-log-config.json
-      - --reload
-      - --reload-dir=/app/cloud
-      - --reload-dir=/app/src
@@
-    # ── Command (override Dockerfile CMD to enable auto-reload) ────
-    # Uvicorn watches cloud/ and src/ via watchfiles; restarts only
-    # the worker process (~0.5s), not the container.
+    # ── Command (single process for retained-session affinity) ───────
     command:
-      - uvicorn
-      - cloud.app:app
-      - --host=${HOST:-0.0.0.0}
-      - --port=${PORT:-8686}
-      - --log-config=cloud/uvicorn-log-config.json
-      - --reload
-      - --reload-dir=/app/cloud
-      - --reload-dir=/app/src
+      - python
+      - -m
+      - cloud.server
@@
       HOST: "${HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
       PORT: "${PORT:-8686}"
+      UVICORN_RELOAD: "${UVICORN_RELOAD:-0}"
@@
-      # Source code (bind-mounted for instant visibility + uvicorn --reload)
+      # Source code (bind-mounted for deliberate development reloads)
@@
-    # Only used for dependency-change rebuilds.  Code hot-reload is
-    # handled by bind mounts + uvicorn --reload (faster, no log gap).
+    # Only used for dependency-change rebuilds.
*** Update File: $REPO_JOB_HUNTER/.env.example
@@
 # Retained browser sessions are process-local. Uvicorn must remain single-worker.
 WEB_CONCURRENCY=1
+# Keep disabled for retained-session/manual QA runs. Set to 1 only for local
+# development when losing paused sessions on code changes is acceptable.
+UVICORN_RELOAD=0
*** End Patch
